SR2E.Spirits96.Why.trueName: {name} is a free spirit: only someone who knows its true name can banish it.
SR2E.Spirits96.Why.assenseAgain: {name} can't read {target}'s aura again: the target number ({tn}) is above their Magic.
SR2E.Spirits96.Why.cleanseGrade: {name} can't cleanse a background count of {count}: an initiate cleanses only a count up to their grade ({grade}).
SR2E.Spirits96.Wait.used: {name} has hung around for a day or more: {used} more service(s) used up, {left} left.
SR2E.Spirits96.Wait.departs: {name} has hung around for a day or more: its last service is used up and it departs.
SR2E.Spirits96.Disrupt.until: {name} is disrupted for {days} day(s): it can't appear again before day {day} of the world clock.
SR2E.Spirits96.Disrupt.watcher: {name} is a watcher: knocked out, it is destroyed for good.
SR2E.Spirits96.Disrupt.back: {name}'s disruption is over: it can appear again.
SR2E.Spirits96.Watcher.hours: Hours a watcher serves (its target number)
SR2E.Spirits96.Watcher.dissolves: {name}'s time is up: the watcher dissolves into astral space.
SR2E.Spirits96.TrueName.title: Banish {name}
SR2E.Spirits96.TrueName.label: This is a free spirit. Its true name:
SR2E.Spirits96.Aid.title: {name}'s aid
SR2E.Spirits96.Aid.label: Dice from {name}'s aid to add to spell defense ({left} left)
SR2E.Spirits96.Tech.note: its own enhancements don't count against a spirit (−{power} Power)
SR2E.Spirits96.Reflect.dissipates: {spell} is reflected at Force 1 and dissipates.
SR2E.Spirits96.Reflect.name: {spell} (reflected)
SR2E.Spirits96.Confusion.tn: Confused: +{tn} to every target number while in the being's terrain; a Willpower test against its Essence for every decision.
SR2E.Spirits96.Fear.runs: Fear ({net} net): the victim runs like crazy.
SR2E.Spirits96.Fear.stays: Fear ({net} net): the victim runs and does not come back.
SR2E.Spirits96.Fear.sweats: Fear ({net} net): the victim flees, does not come back, and sweats blood at any mention of the being or the place.
SR2E.Spirits96.Fear.phobia: Fear ({net} net): the victim flees and is left with a disabling phobia.
SR2E.Spirits96.Engulf.walk: Engulfed: the victim is drawn in at walking pace.
SR2E.Spirits96.Engulf.run: Engulfed: the victim is drawn in at running speed.
SR2E.Spirits96.Engulf.escape: On each of their actions the victim may break free with a net success of Strength against the being's Essence.
SR2E.Spirits96.Duel.title: Spirit against spirit (Force against Force)
SR2E.Spirits96.Duel.destroyed: {name} loses {loss} Force and is destroyed: it can't be called again.
SR2E.Spirits96.Tool.title: Spirits (book rules)
SR2E.Spirits96.Tool.hint: Select two spirit tokens for a Force against Force contest (Core p. 143): each roll is one round. The fight costs a controlled spirit one service (take it off its sheet); it may go on until one spirit is destroyed.
SR2E.Tools.spirits96.label: Spirits (book rules, GM)
SR2E.Tools.spirits96.hint: For two selected spirit tokens: a Force against Force contest.
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__elemen: Elemental's day of waiting: a called elemental (a token on a scene) uses a service every 24 hours, Core p. 141 (book) or may wait for ever (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__aidDef: Aid Sorcery in spell defense: dice left in an elemental's aid may join spell defense, Core p. 141 (book) or help casting only (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__techVs: Tech melee enhancements vs spirits: a weapon's own Power tweaks don't count against a manifest spirit, Awakenings p. 101 (book) or count (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__spirit: Spirit against spirit: Force against Force in the GM's Spirits tool, Core p. 143 (book) or no tool (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__disrup: Disruption: a disrupted spirit is away 28 − Force days with a return date, Grimoire p. 64 (book) or no date (v951)
Disruption (book): days of the cycle the Force is taken from (28)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__freeSp: Free spirits: only someone who knows the true name can banish one, Grimoire p. 77 (book) or anyone (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__watche: Watchers: TN = hours, Force from successes, (Force × hours)L Stun Drain, dissolve after their hours, Grimoire p. 73 (book) or a Force 1 spirit (v951)
Watchers (book): hours a watcher serves when not given
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__astral: Astral attack skill: Unarmed (Armed with a weapon focus) Combat or Sorcery, the better, Core p. 147 (book) or the astral attack skill only (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__assens: Reading an aura again: +2 TN per earlier attempt, none above Magic, Grimoire p. 90 (book) or no limit (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__reflec: Reflecting: shielding dice's successes only, the spell rebounds at the net Force, Awakenings p. 99 (book) or all resistance successes bounce (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__cleans: Cleansing: a count up to the grade only, then (count)D Willpower Drain, Awakenings p. 100 (book) or any count, no Drain (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__adeptC: Imported adept power costs: by band (attributes, Improved Ability) and Distance Strike double beside Killing Hands, Core pp. 125–126, Awakenings p. 116 (book) or flat guesses (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__critte: Confusion, Fear, Engulf: Essence against Willpower, Confusion half the net successes, Fear's severity, Engulf's escape, Predator and Prey pp. 89–92 (book) or the power's own dice (v951)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SPIRITS_V96__astral: Astral Combat Pool while perceiving: astral actions of a perceiving magician use the Astral Combat Pool, Core p. 147 (book) or the Combat Pool (v951)
